attempted_claim: Let C be an irreducible complex projective plane curve of degree 7, rational (geometric genus 0), whose non-nodal singularities are exactly one ordinary cusp of analytic type A2 (delta-invariant 1, Tjurina number 2) and one tacnode of analytic type A3 (local equation y^2=x^4, two smooth branches with common tangent, delta-invariant 2, Tjurina number 3) in distinct positions, and whose remaining singularities are exactly 12 ordinary nodes. Impose passage through 18 points in general position in P^2. Using the Jun Li relative Gromov-Witten degeneration of the smooth pair (P^2,Q) along a smooth conic Q (total class 7L, contact orders partitioning 14 along Q, including a stated two-branch tangency profile for the tacnode) with its full degeneration-ledger sum, plus (C*)^2 torus localization evaluations of the contributing relative and rubber invariants, prove finiteness and transversality under the 18 point conditions and determine with proof the exact finite enumerative number N(7,A2+A3) counting such mixed cusp-tacnode curves (each singularity assignment counted once, nodes unordered). A complete answer is a proved nonnegative integer value together with the certified ledger sum and localization contributions yielding it.
claim_type: exact finite enumerative number with certified ledger
decisive_failure: No enumerative value was certified: zero ledger rows, zero relative or rubber localization evaluations, and no transversality proof were completed. The Kontsevich table, dimension check, and partition census are routine verifications only. The exact integer N(7,A2+A3) remains undetermined, and the ledger-size lower bound is a blocking diagnostic, not an independently valuable result.
